name: Oath of Shelter
effect: Set exclusive oath Shelter: physical damage dealt x0.90; intercept the first single-target hit against an ally below 35% HP per enemy action, taking 50% of that hit. Cannot intercept area attacks or recurse.

name: Shieldbreak
effect: Deal damage, then apply Guardbreak for 3 target actions; no stacking beyond the common status definition.

name: Oath of Wrath
effect: Replace any oath. Physical damage dealt x1.20 and physical damage received x1.15; persists until changed or battle ends.

name: Cinderedge
effect: Fire-aspected weapon strike; can break flammable seals but cannot bypass plot gates.

name: Oath of Sacrifice
effect: Replace any oath. Once per enemy action, transfer 25% of another ally’s received direct damage to Dain. Transfer cannot reduce Dain below 1 HP and is capped at 10% of his max HP per action.

name: Rally
effect: Remove Weaken and apply Barrier for 2 target actions. Does not revive fallen allies.

name: Oath of Witness
effect: Replace any oath. Immune to Silence and Blind; after an ally is hit, next direct attack gains +20% power, one charge only.

name: Open Hand
effect: Dispel removable hostile statuses from living allies and grant Barrier for 3 target actions. Once per battle, also prevent one lethal direct hit on each ally, leaving 1 HP. Does not bypass scripted losses or resurrect.

name: Ember Lance
effect: Single-target fire spell with 20% Burn chance after a hit.

name: Rime Needle
effect: Single-target ice spell; 25% Slow chance.

name: Storm Arc
effect: Hit each living enemy once; no additional chaining on a single target.

name: Stone Seal
effect: Damage plus 40% Guardbreak chance; flying foes resist earth unless grounded.

name: Overcast
effect: Arm one next elemental spell: MP cost x1.75 rounded up, power x1.40, and after resolution lose 8% max HP nonlethally. No random fizzle. Arm costs a turn; consumed only on successful spell commit.

name: Black Sun
effect: Area shadow spell. Undead affinity follows the target’s data, not appearance guessing.

name: Heat Exchange
effect: Convert 15% current HP, minimum 1 nonlethal HP, into 20 MP; usable once between Tessa’s damaging spells, maximum three times per battle.

name: Ash Without Fire
effect: Light spell; remove one positive removable status from each hit enemy. Overcast is allowed with its full cost and self-damage.

name: Updraft
effect: Leave targetable field for 1.2 simulation seconds, then land for damage. No ATB charging while airborne; encounter does not end while a living ally is airborne.

name: Harrow Dive
effect: Airborne strike with +30% damage against Marked targets, consumed without removing Mark.

name: Anchorfall
effect: Ground a flying target for 2 target actions if not immune; boss immunity still allows damage.

name: Skypiercer
effect: Ignore 35% of target DEF, not all defense. No critical multiplier beyond the standard cap.

name: Feather Guard
effect: Reduce the next direct damaging action by 60%, then expire; cannot stack with a second copy.

name: Storm Vault
effect: One leap followed by one damage instance per living enemy; no extra hits for sprite segments.

name: Wingbeat
effect: Advance each living ally’s ATB by 120 of 1000, excluding Corren; once per Corren readiness cycle. Cannot queue duplicate turns.

name: Unbound Descent
effect: Aerial strike; on landing grant Corren and the lowest-HP living ally Barrier for 2 actions. Landing is guaranteed unless battle already legitimately ended.

name: Rivet Shot
effect: Ranged physical hit; ignores back-row outgoing penalty.

name: Field Patch
effect: Restore HP using the heal formula. Works in battle and exploration; not a revive.

name: Grounding Rod
effect: Grant storm resistance x0.50 for 3 target actions; strongest resistance wins rather than multiplying copies.

name: Steam Screen
effect: Apply Barrier for 2 actions and 20% physical evasion bonus for one incoming direct action.

name: Clock Mine
effect: Attach one mine; detonate immediately after that enemy’s next resolved action. Reapplication refreshes without duplicate mines.

name: Pressure Vent
effect: Remove Burn and grant Regen for 3 target actions.

name: Decoy Frame
effect: Create one team decoy with HP equal to 25% Ivo max HP; draws the next two eligible single-target enemy attacks. Area damage affects it but still hits the party.

name: Unborrowed Engine
effect: Apply Haste for 3 actions and restore 15 MP per living ally. Once per battle. Net MP creation cannot be repeated via revive.

name: Hunter’s Mark
effect: Apply Mark for 4 target actions and reveal exact elemental affinities in the bestiary.

name: Split Arrow
effect: One arrow per living enemy; ranged; applies no additional hits when only one enemy remains.

name: Snare
effect: Apply Slow with 90% base chance; on normal enemies also delay ATB by 150. Bosses take the bounded Slow effect only.

name: Bramble Ward
effect: Apply Barrier for 3 target actions; reflect 15% of absorbed direct physical damage once per source action, with reflection recursion disabled.

name: Scent Trail
effect: Reveal drops, steal eligibility and next committed enemy move; same information remains after the battle.

name: Exposed Thread
effect: Ranged strike; +25% damage against Guardbreak or Mark, not +25% for each.

name: True North
effect: Remove Blind and apply Focus for 3 actions; no effect on story directions or hidden map gates.

name: Many Paths
effect: Ranged volley; apply Mark to survivors. Grant one charge of 50% flee-meter progress in flee-eligible battles only.

name: Mend
effect: Single-target healing, usable in battle or exploration. Against an undead enemy requires an explicit hostile target selection and deals equivalent light damage.

name: Cleanse
effect: Remove Poison, Burn, Bleed, Blind, Silence and Sleep. Not Doom, stun or boss-specific narrative seals.

name: Sunthread
effect: Heal each living ally. Does not damage enemies by changing target mode.

name: Last Light
effect: Revive one fallen ally at 25% maximum HP; target must still be fallen at resolution.

name: Omen
effect: Reveal next scheduled move and its target; delay that enemy’s ATB by 100, maximum once per enemy action cycle. Does not read future random decisions.

name: Intercede
effect: Grant one protection charge: the next direct hit cannot reduce this ally below 1 HP. Expires after 3 target actions; does not stop poison at 1 HP.

name: Stillwater
effect: Remove Slow and Doom; grant Regen for 3 actions. No automatic resurrection.

name: Borrowed Dawn
effect: Revive fallen allies at 20% HP, then heal the whole party. Once per battle, committed with a valid resolution and not reset by Oriel’s death.

name: Infuse Ember
effect: Set one weapon infusion to fire for 4 Sable actions; her next normal Attack applies 25% Burn chance. Infusions do not stack.

name: Infuse Rime
effect: Replace infusion with ice for 4 Sable actions; next normal Attack applies 25% Slow chance.

name: Infuse Storm
effect: Replace infusion with storm for 4 Sable actions; next normal Attack ignores 15% DEF.

name: Unseal
effect: Remove one removable positive status, selecting the oldest; if none exists, deal a 60-power magic strike of the current infusion or light.

name: Mirror Cut
effect: Damage using current infusion; then gain one 30% magic-reduction charge. This is not recursive spell reflection.

name: Sever Rune
effect: Deal light-aspected physical damage and apply Silence with 50% base chance; boss immunity does not cancel damage.

name: Runic Shelter
effect: Apply Barrier for 3 actions and light/shadow resistance x0.75 for 3 actions; strongest affinity modifier wins.

name: Unwritten Law
effect: Remove all removable positive statuses before damage; party gains one immunity charge against the next removable hostile status. Cannot delete boss phase scripts.

name: Pilfer
effect: Attempt a common steal at 70%, rare at 10% if common already taken. After three common failures, common succeeds. One common and one rare per enemy instance; no mandatory progression items.

name: Feint
effect: Damage plus 50% Blind chance. Ranged immunity does not apply; this is a melee move.

name: Smoke
effect: Advance flee meter by 500 of 1000 in flee-eligible battles; otherwise grant 15% physical evasion for one incoming action.

name: Quick Hands
effect: Arm one Item action with 50% ATB refund after valid resolution. Consume exactly one item; effects cannot recursively arm Quick Hands.

name: Tripwire
effect: Damage and delay target ATB by 150; bosses cap combined delays at 200 between their actions.

name: Disarm
effect: Damage and apply Weaken for 3 target actions; no actual removal of boss loot or equipped player items.

name: Rescue Line
effect: Remove one removable hard-control status, move the ally to back row and apply Barrier for 2 actions. Does not reposition exploration characters.

name: False Crown
effect: Apply Weaken and Guardbreak to living enemies with 100% base chance subject to immunity. Cancel one pending normal-enemy charge, never a boss phase transition.

name: Kindle
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Rime Dust
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Static Thread
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Salt Wash
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Small Renewal
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Clock Nudge
effect: Apply Slow for 2 target actions at 75% base chance.

name: Night Veil
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Day Seal
effect: Use the standard damage or healing formula; this accessory grants access only while equipped.

name: Ember Moth
effect: Fire damage to all enemies at 180 power; allies gain Burn immunity for 2 actions.

name: Rootstag
effect: Earth damage to all enemies at 170 power; heal allies for 8% max HP.

name: Bell Whale
effect: Water damage at 170 power to all enemies; cleanse Silence and Sleep from allies.

name: Sky Manta
effect: Storm damage to all enemies at 180 power; advance living allies’ ATB by 100, no duplicate turns.

name: Lumen Fox
effect: Heal all living allies at 140 power and reveal enemies’ current scheduled intents.

name: Iron Tortoise
effect: Grant Barrier and Regen for 3 actions to all living allies; no damage.

name: Winter Hind
effect: Ice damage to all enemies at 210 power; remove Doom from living allies.

name: Night Leviathan
effect: Shadow damage to all enemies at 220 power; remove one positive removable enemy status.
